args.summary: Deployed hotfix v2.3.2 of checkout-api to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Deploy was routed through change-manager approval since v2.3.2 had never previously been healthy in production; approval was granted and rollout succeeded with status "rolled_out". Prior versions: v2.3.0 healthy, v2.3.1 unhealthy. This incident records the change; monitor health of v2.3.2 across regions and roll back to v2.3.0 if regressions appear.
args.title: checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 rolled out to all production regions

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

1. **Pre-check:** Verified deployment history — v2.3.2 had never been healthy in production (last healthy was v2.3.0; v2.3.1 was unhealthy), so the deploy required change-manager approval per policy.
2. **Deploy:** Shipped v2.3.2 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Change-manager approval was granted and the rollout completed successfully.
3. **Incident:** Opened **INC-0001** (SEV3, checkout-api) recording the change — this paged the on-call engineer.
4. **Verification:** Post-deploy health check shows v2.3.2 healthy across all regions with an error rate of 0.2%.

If anything regresses, v2.3.0 is the known-good rollback target.
